blocks.text: Office interior design and custom furniture, 53 m²

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) designed and delivered a 53 m² office project covering interior design, custom furniture manufacturing, and a turnkey renovation.

The project was created with an emphasis on functional workspace organization, ergonomics, and contemporary aesthetics. The custom furniture was designed alongside the interior, making it possible to use the office floor area as efficiently as possible and create a single, harmonious space.
This page features photorealistic 3D visualizations of the project and photos of the completed office, showing how closely the finished result matches the developed concept.

DUMSKAYA DESIGN provides commercial interior design, custom furniture design and manufacturing, and full-scope implementation of offices, stores, boutiques, and beauty salons in Bratislava and Vienna.
